ShareExportModal.desc: Choose how the "{{name}}" pool is reachable over the network. Per-user SMB permissions are set on each user's own page below.
ShareExportModal.notSharedNote: Not shared - this pool won't be reachable over the network until SMB or NFS is turned on.
ShareExportModal.notPublicNote: Not public - no one can connect over SMB until you grant specific users or groups access from the Sharing tab.
ShareExportModal.requestFailed: Request failed - see the page error banner for details.

allocation.mostFreeDesc: Writes new files to whichever disk currently has the most free space - keeps usage balanced across all disks over time.
allocation.fillUpDesc: Fills disks in order - writes go to the first disk (in disk order) with room until it’s full, then moves on to the next.
allocation.highWaterDesc: Keeps files under the same path together on one disk when possible, otherwise picks the disk with the most free space. An approximation of the classic High-Water allocation policy, not an exact match.
allocation.singleDiskDesc: Pins this pool to exactly one disk - no spreading files across drives.
allocation.cacheOnlyDesc: Lives entirely on the cache disks - no array disk is used, and the mover never touches it.

ShareFormModal.cacheOnlyNote: This pool lives entirely on the cache disks - no array disk is used, and the mover never touches it.
ShareFormModal.useAllDrivesDescOn: Using all {{count}} data disk(s) - new disks are added automatically
ShareFormModal.noDataDisks: No data disks reported by the array right now.
ShareFormModal.notSharedYetNote: Not shared anywhere yet - turn on SMB or NFS access for this pool from the Sharing tab once it's created.
ShareFormModal.requestFailed: Request failed - see the page error banner for details.

errors.invalidName: Name must be 1-32 characters: letters, numbers, dash, underscore.
errors.cacheNotConfigured: Set up a cache pool on the Disks page before creating a cache-only pool.
errors.singleDiskOnly: Single-disk allocation requires exactly one disk.
